lastText: The Campaign EndsThe Broken KeyNew Ending Found · 1 / 16AUTOMATON SIGHTED OUTSIDE INGOLSTADT, UNACCOMPANIEDIt walks out of the tower and keeps walking, past the curtain wall, past the town, into country no one thinks to search because no one imagines an automaton would simply leave. It is seen twice more that winter, always alone, always moving with a strange, unhurried purpose no observer can name. Victor tells the university the harness failed. He does not correct anyone who calls it a malfunction, and he does not sleep well for a long time afterward, though not, he finds, from guilt. There is no gentler version of this story left to tell.
